latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Board Game Night Host skill:

- Provides a comprehensive guide to hosting engaging, inclusive board game nights.
- Features a game selection engine based on group size, experience, preferences, and time available.
- Includes rapid rule-teaching strategies and sample scripts for clear, fast game introductions.
- Covers hosting logistics, crowd management, troubleshooting, and post-game routines.
- Emphasizes player inclusion, accessibility, and safety best practices for all group types.
